body:
## Runtime 1.0.1 native recovery

PR #203 merged at 9d2cd7c774013975c7968210b584df33bfa94257. Focused workflow tests: 75 passed. Signing is optional with all credentials absent; partial platform credentials fail closed. PyPI was not republished.

Immutable release source/tag: actions-runtime-1.0.1 → 0accc8f8cd1590957dec63d94e091aa945653614, unchanged.

Recovery run 34150010615: immutable source admission and all three native builds PASS. PyPI recovery SKIPPED. Publication failed because gh release had no explicit repository outside the two nested checkouts. The already-built artifacts were downloaded and published using the existing helper with GH_REPO set; draft lookup required the release-ID endpoint. Exact three-file inventory and SHA-256 matched before publication. No rebuild or second dispatch occurred.

Public GitHub release: https://github.com/joshyorko/actions/releases/tag/actions-runtime-1.0.1

All three platforms are explicitly identified as UNSIGNED in the release notes, with hashes:
- Linux: 191f40cfebcadbd53bf7b14988098b983b99b4efc1aa8d8ac9e8ada6ad37ab3b
- macOS arm64: 7e9ea6960107d6f6da6dadd7fd12a2c63f9c065d2a9f296aba765b34d24c47d8
- Windows x64: ce09cebc3f6f1f7ae3537e5b000092a8d54baedafbadd9d349b12aa53117a307

Public downloads of all three artifacts: hashes PASS. Downloaded Linux binary: version 1.0.1, startup, MCP hello Action returning Hello Mr. Runtime. PASS. Post-download Windows/macOS execution: NOT RUN on this Linux host; their hosted builds passed.

Distribution handoff remains BLOCKED: configured CDN is Sema4AI's legacy action-server namespace. Its 1.0.1 Linux object is dated 2024-09-26 and is 158556587 bytes, unlike this recovered 81666089-byte Linux binary. A matching version.txt is not provenance. Configured Sema4AI/homebrew-tools is read-only for the authenticated account, with no GH_PAT_GHA_TO_ANOTHER_REPO secret. S3/CDN/Homebrew steps were not executed. Do not overwrite the unrelated legacy 1.0.1 release. Josh's own homebrew-tools tap is writable but uses a different pipeline and still describes legacy 1.2.6; migration of that handoff requires an explicit target decision.

Documentation improvement:
- Canonical file changed: docs/skills/repository-operations.md, native recovery paragraph in PR #203.
- Durable learning captured: optional signing, partial-credential rejection, pinned 1.0.1 source, PyPI skip, reused handoff helpers.
- Evidence: 75 workflow tests and recovery run above.
- Stale guidance removed: mandatory paid signing for recovery.
- Remaining uncertainty: distribution handoff ownership and post-download macOS/Windows execution. Proposed next correction: recovery gh calls need explicit repository and release-ID lookup for drafts; no new tag/version is required.
